target: forge.sh pr-create (none) — prints local and exits 0 with no forge call (control: a pr-state in the same run does reach the transport)
cmd:
. "$FIXTURES/forge/setup.sh"; fx_init
fx_remote https://gitlab.example.test/grp/proj.git
export FORGE=none FORGE_TOKEN=glpat-FAKE-not-a-real-token-0001
fx_http "GET /api/v4/projects/grp%2Fproj/merge_requests?source_branch=feat&state=opened" 200 '[]'
fx_http "POST /api/v4/projects/grp%2Fproj/merge_requests" 201 '{"iid":3,"web_url":"https://gitlab.example.test/grp/proj/-/merge_requests/3"}'
fx_http "GET /api/v4/projects/grp%2Fproj/merge_requests/7" 200 '{"state":"merged"}'
fx_gh pr_list 0 ''; fx_gh pr_create 0 'https://github.com/o/r/pull/1'
fx_run pr-create --head feat --base main --title T --body-file body.md; fx_show r
echo "requests_before=$(fx_nreq)"; echo "calls_before=$(fx_ncalls)"
fx_run pr-state https://gitlab.example.test/grp/proj/-/merge_requests/7
echo "control=$FX_OUT"; echo "requests_after=$(fx_nreq)"
fx_done
